summary: Grupo Supervielle S.A., an Argentine financial holding company, furnished its Form 6-K containing condensed interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, in accordance with Rule 13a-16. The filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer, presenting consolidated and separate financial statements, notes, and schedules. It does not announce any merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event. The content is purely financial reporting with no strategic corporate action, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms. For a US-equivalent, it corresponds to a Form 10-Q filing. No market-moving event is indicated; investors would review for earnings trends and Argentine economic context only.
